---
title: "Process Reference"
---

This page lists the 109 processes available on [`https://data.fao.org/openeo`](https://data.fao.org/openeo/processes). It is generated from the live `/processes` endpoint with `scripts/generate_process_reference.py`.

Standard openEO processes behave as described in the [openEO process documentation](https://processes.openeo.org/); follow the links for full details. FAO-specific processes are described below. Standard processes with FAO notes link to [FAO Processes](fao_processes.qmd).

In Python, call any process with `cube.process("<id>", ...)` or `connection.datacube_from_process("<id>", ...)`. In the Web Editor, search for the process ID in the process list.

## FAO-specific processes

These processes aren't part of the standard openEO catalogue. See [FAO Processes](fao_processes.qmd) for usage notes and examples.

### `zonal_stats`

FAO zonal statistics with feature properties carried through.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `data_cube` | Data Cube | yes |  | xarray DataArray or Dataset to analyze |
| `geometries` | geojson, object | yes |  | Geometry, Feature, or FeatureCollection to analyze |
| `stats` | array | no |  | Stats to calculate. Supported: ['min', 'max', 'mean', 'count', 'sum', 'std', 'var', 'median', 'range'] |
| `categorical` | boolean | no | `false` | Categorical analysis mode |
| `all_touched` | boolean | no | `true` | Include boundary pixels |

### `crtb_analysis`

Climate Risk Toolbox hazard, vulnerability, exposure and adaptive capacity.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `analysis_id` | `Hazards_Baseline` / `Hazards_Near_Term_RCP_2.6` / `Hazards_Near_Term_RCP_8.5` / `Hazards_Mid_Term_RCP_2.6` / `Hazards_Mid_Term_RCP_8.5` / `Vulnerability_Baseline` / `adaptiveCapacity_Baseline` / `Exposure_Baseline` | no | `"Hazards_Baseline"` | The ID of the analysis to perform |
| `geometry_type` | `geojson` / `feature_collection` | no | `"geojson"` | Type of geometry input: 'geojson' or 'feature_collection' |
| `geojson` | geojson, object | yes |  | The geometry data - either a GeoJSON object or feature collection configuration |

### `load_geojson_url`

Load polygons from a GeoJSON URL.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | yes |  | The URL to load the geojson from. |

### `load_fiona_feature_collection`

Load boundaries from the FAO geospatial catalogue.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `feature_collection` | object | yes |  | The feature collection to load. |

### `pixel_count`

Count occurrences of each pixel value.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | Data | yes |  | An array of numbers. |
| `ignore_nodata` | boolean | no | `true` | Whether to ignore no-data values. |

### `maze_varieties`

PLAN-T: maize varieties suitable for a location.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `latitude` | number | yes |  | The latitude of the point |
| `longitude` | number | yes |  | The longitude of the point |

### `planting_recommendation`

PLAN-T: whether a planting date is suitable.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `planting_date` | string | yes |  | The date in YYYY-MM-DD format |
| `latitude` | number | yes |  | The latitude of the point |
| `longitude` | number | yes |  | The longitude of the point |

### `cs_assessment`

PLAN-T: climate stressors for a planting date.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `date` | string | yes |  | The date in YYYY-MM-DD format |
| `latitude` | number | yes |  | The latitude of the point |
| `longitude` | number | yes |  | The longitude of the point |
| `maze_varieties` | array | yes |  | The maze varieties |
| `climate_stressors` | array | yes |  | The climate stressors |

### `sign`

Alias of `sgn`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | number | yes |  | A number. |

## Standard openEO processes

### Loading data

| Process | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`load_collection`](https://processes.openeo.org/#load_collection) | Load a collection |
| [`load_url`](https://processes.openeo.org/#load_url) | Load data from a URL ([FAO notes](fao_processes.qmd#load_url)) |

### Saving and exporting

| Process | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`export_workspace`](https://processes.openeo.org/#export_workspace) | Export data to a cloud workspace ([FAO notes](fao_processes.qmd#export_workspace)) |
| [`save_result`](https://processes.openeo.org/#save_result) | Save processed data |

### Filtering

| Process | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`filter_bands`](https://processes.openeo.org/#filter_bands) | Filter the bands by names |
| [`filter_bbox`](https://processes.openeo.org/#filter_bbox) | Spatial filter using a bounding box |
| [`filter_labels`](https://processes.openeo.org/#filter_labels) | Filter dimension labels based on a condition |
| [`filter_spatial`](https://processes.openeo.org/#filter_spatial) | Spatial filter raster data cubes using geometries |
| [`filter_temporal`](https://processes.openeo.org/#filter_temporal) | Temporal filter based on temporal intervals |

### Data cube operations

| Process | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`add_dimension`](https://processes.openeo.org/#add_dimension) | Add a new dimension |
| [`aggregate_spatial`](https://processes.openeo.org/#aggregate_spatial) | Zonal statistics for geometries ([FAO notes](fao_processes.qmd#aggregate_spatial-extension)) |
| [`aggregate_temporal`](https://processes.openeo.org/#aggregate_temporal) | Temporal aggregations |
| [`aggregate_temporal_period`](https://processes.openeo.org/#aggregate_temporal_period) | Temporal aggregation by calendar period |
| [`apply`](https://processes.openeo.org/#apply) | Apply a process to each value |
| [`apply_dimension`](https://processes.openeo.org/#apply_dimension) | Apply a process to all values along a dimension |
| [`apply_kernel`](https://processes.openeo.org/#apply_kernel) | Apply a spatial convolution with a kernel |
| [`climatological_normal`](https://processes.openeo.org/#climatological_normal) | Compute climatological normals ([FAO notes](fao_processes.qmd#climatological_normal)) |
| [`dimension_labels`](https://processes.openeo.org/#dimension_labels) | Get dimension labels |
| [`drop_dimension`](https://processes.openeo.org/#drop_dimension) | Remove a dimension |
| [`mask`](https://processes.openeo.org/#mask) | Apply a raster mask |
| [`mask_polygon`](https://processes.openeo.org/#mask_polygon) | Apply a polygon mask |
| [`merge_cubes`](https://processes.openeo.org/#merge_cubes) | Merge two data cubes |
| [`reduce_dimension`](https://processes.openeo.org/#reduce_dimension) | Reduce dimensions |
| [`rename_dimension`](https://processes.openeo.org/#rename_dimension) | Rename a dimension |
| [`rename_labels`](https://processes.openeo.org/#rename_labels) | Rename dimension labels |
| [`resample_cube_spatial`](https://processes.openeo.org/#resample_cube_spatial) | Resample the spatial dimensions to match a target data cube |
| [`resample_cube_temporal`](https://processes.openeo.org/#resample_cube_temporal) | Resample temporal dimensions to match a target data cube |
| [`resample_spatial`](https://processes.openeo.org/#resample_spatial) | Resample and warp the spatial dimensions |
